context.narrative_job: Expose the difference between retained business assets and an operating decision that departs with the owner.
context.viewer_before: Owner knows the business; diagrams currently assert dependence through headings.
context.viewer_after: Viewer observes an employee complete work with an owner decision, then wait at a fresh decision when that owner is absent.

data.choice: Propose one fixed workshop action, tested first as a short movement study around the conditional passage. Worker offers alternatives, owner chooses, work finishes; owner exits; another task reaches a fresh choice and remains unfinished while employee and equipment stay. Simplify coverage elsewhere instead of illustrating each spoken noun.
data.reason: R39 never shows the worker doing work or needing a decision. Making the causal intervention observable can let the viewer infer the dependence. Fewer labels or neater paths alone would preserve the failure.

alternatives.choice: Keep the existing tray/book diagram with fewer labels
alternatives.reason_not_selected: It would reduce clutter without establishing why the worker can or cannot complete the task.

alternatives.choice: Use narration with a short departure and unfinished-work insert
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Retained as the simpler fallback if the short movement study cannot make the enabling decision and later absence legible.

reuse.applies_when: A claimed visual mechanism is carried mainly by its explanatory headings and an enabling action can be physically staged.
reuse.avoid_when: The scene is attributable evidence or a relationship that needs labels; a mute/text-free diagnostic is not a universal publishing rule.

animation.form: One physical task and a missing decision in one fixed illustrated workspace
animation.entry: Establish employee, owner and the decision needed to complete work
animation.change: Owner leaves; a different task reaches a new decision without its answer
animation.hold: Employee and equipment remain with unfinished work and empty owner position
animation.exit: Exact exit and preceding coverage remain to be set after movement study

cut_cues.phrase: And if that machine turns out to be her ... It does not survive the handover.
cut_cues.relation: Proposed short action region; not frame-locked pending movement test

nuance.performance: The employee must visibly seek a fresh decision; simply forgetting an identical demonstrated step would imply incompetence.
nuance.false_inference: This is an illustrative conditional, not evidence that the actual seller business fails or every dependency is a production task.
nuance.source_basis: Current owner critique plus director diagnosis of R39 encoded frames, composition source and locked narration.

evidence.locator: Concrete sequence, script mapping, proposed diagnostic and limits
Six explanatory titles and no performed worker action
